modpack.title: Menu & Field Guide update
notes: Trainer Database rebuilt: switch between a 4-across grid and a list view, search trainers, filter by favourite Pokémon or last update, and click any card to enlarge it
Trainer Card uploads no longer need a token — press sync and your card goes to the team for approval
New Patch Notes panel on the title screen with Modpack and Server tabs
Live event banner on the title screen and pause menu with a countdown
Pause menu quick links for Skills, Events, Trainer and Titles
Field Guide: new guides for Trainer Rank, titles, skill trees, events, Chronoshards, bounties and more, and screenshots load much faster
Removed the singleplayer button — Tempus is server-only

server.title: Themed events & Chronoshards
notes: Themed server events with personal objectives that pay Chronoshards
Chronoshard Shop with items, caches, titles and shiny Poké-Hats
Community goal leaderboards — top contributors earn bonus rewards
Profession capstones at levels 60, 80 and 100

server.title: Server events & community goals
notes: Double XP events for professions and Trainer Rank
Server-wide community goals everyone contributes to
Check what's running any time with /events

server.title: Profession skill trees
notes: Miner and Botanist skill trees — open them with /skills
Earn a skill point every 5 profession levels and pick one of three keystones
Free respec once every 24 hours

server.title: Trainer Rank, titles & bounties
notes: Account-wide Trainer Rank — earn XP from quests, battles, catches and bounties
Rank-ups pay Trainer Support Caches, with bigger rewards every 5 ranks
Researcher profession levels up as your Pokédex fills
Earnable chat titles you can equip with /titles
Trainer Card with your rank and progress: /trainer
Bronze, Silver and Gold bounty boards
